hook: People don't seek out good listeners because they respect them. They seek them out because they need an emotional trash can.
full_script: People don't seek out good listeners because they respect them. They seek them out because they need an emotional trash can. Notice what happens when you finish absorbing someone's two-hour crisis. They leave feeling lighter, and you walk away poisoned. Yet the moment you need support, their schedule is suddenly packed. In human hierarchy, someone who absorbs pain without demanding reciprocity is never respected. They are categorized as safe, docile, and disposable. Unconditional empathy is not a virtue. It is a psychological surrender that invites predators into your living room. Stop hosting auditions for people who only want your peace to cure their chaos. Protect your bandwidth, or spend your life paying the rent on other people's trauma.
